scope: Reconstruction of published 2D cantilever geometry, inputs and reference results for shape-optimization comparison.

lian.title: Implementation of regularized isogeometric boundary element methods for gradient-based shape optimization in two-dimensional linear elasticity
lian.locator: Author postprint Section 6.2.1, Table II, Figures 36–42. Vector coordinates for Figures 37 and 40 read from pages 42–43 of the author postprint.

sun.title: Structural shape optimization by IGABEM and particle swarm optimization algorithm
sun.locator: Section 5.1, Equation (21), Tables 1–2, Figures 3–8. The Table 2 MMA values reproduce Lian et al.'s Table II.

units: Use the model and material values in consistent units. Sun et al. report generic units.

upper_edge.control_order: x increasing from clamp to free tip. The published result tables number control ordinates in the reverse order.
upper_edge.x_control_source: Exact values from Sun Table 1; same spacing as Lian Figures 37 and 39.
upper_edge.knot_vector_source: Normalized uniform interior knots reconstructed from Lian Fig. 37 vector element markers, checked against the areas obtained from the two published final control polygons.

material.constitutive_inference: Lian equations (26)–(27) and (97) and Sun equations (8a)–(8b) and (14c) use the plane-strain form. Plane strain is inferred from those equations. A plane-stress membrane solver can match the in-plane plane-strain constitutive tensor using the listed effective material properties.

load.provenance: Lian Figure 37 annotates the final bottom element. Sun Figure 3 and Section 5.1 give the rounded loaded length 5.6. The reconstructed quadratic spline gives an element length of 5.625.

optimization.objective: Minimize the magnitude of the vertical displacement at the free end under distributed traction on the bottom edge.
optimization.objective_reconstruction_note: The publications identify the beam end as the measurement location. Its exact coordinates remain unspecified. A matched check can report the lower-tip value and the maximum vertical displacement over the right edge. The distributed-load compliance measures the work on the loaded bottom-edge interval.
optimization.design_variables: Nine vertical upper-edge control ordinates; fixed x control coordinates.

lian_mma.ordinate_source: Table II, in ascending x order.
lian_mma.objective_source: Vector marker centres scaled to vertical axis [0.3, 1.0], readout only. Paper describes the normalized objective as around 30 percent.
lian_mma.stress_reference: Upper-edge von Mises curves before/after optimization in Figures 41–42.

sun_pso.objective_source: Section 5.1 and Figs. 5 and 8. Use the displacement numbers and their ratio; verify any percentage against those numbers. Equation (21) enforces area at most 220, consistent with Lian and Sun's reported final area.
